name: Leads Directory & Search Filtering
description: Verify lead management directory lists leads with source, status, assigned owner, and supports search

planSteps.description: Navigate to /login and sign in as admin@flowcrm.local
Click 'Leads' in the sidebar navigation to open /leads
Verify the Leads table loads with company names, status badges, and the 'New Lead' button
Click into a lead to view their details page
Verify the lead details view displays company, email, phone, and action buttons
